properties.title: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued September 28 at 6:57AM CDT until September 28 at 7:45AM CDT by NWS Aberdeen SD
properties.description:
SVRABR

The National Weather Service in Aberdeen has issued a

* Severe Thunderstorm Warning for...
South Central Corson County in north central South Dakota...
North Central Dewey County in north central South Dakota...

* Until 645 AM MDT.

* At 557 AM MDT, a severe thunderstorm was located near Little Moreau
Rec Area, or 9 miles south of Timber Lake, moving northeast at 30
mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts and quarter size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Hail damage to vehicles is expected. Expect wind damage to
roofs, siding, and trees.

* This severe thunderstorm will be near...
Little Moreau Rec Area around 600 AM MDT.
Glencross around 620 AM MDT.
Trail City around 635 AM MDT.
properties.instruction:
Seek shelter inside a well-built structure and stay away from
windows. This storm is capable of producing damaging winds and large
hail.

properties.title: Flood Warning issued September 28 at 7:55AM EDT until September 28 at 1:45PM EDT by NWS Boston/Norton MA
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by prolonged heavy rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...Southeastern Worcester County in central Massachusetts...
Southern Norfolk County in eastern Massachusetts...
Northwestern Bristol County in southeastern Massachusetts...
West Central Plymouth County in southeastern Massachusetts...
Northeastern Providence County in Rhode Island...

* WHEN...Until 145 PM EDT.

* IMPACTS...Flooding of rivers, creeks, streams, and other low-lying
and flood-prone locations is imminent or occurring. Streams
continue to rise due to excess runoff from previous rainfall.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 747 AM EDT, Doppler radar indicated continued light to at
times moderate rain falling over the warned area. Between 3 and 6
inches of rain have fallen over the last 48 hours in the warned
area. Additional rainfall expected through this morning could
lead to areas of street and poor drainage flooding. The
Blackstone River above Woonsocket is now in minor flood stage
levels at 11.96 ft, which leads to low- lying flooding along
portions of Cumberland and Woonsocket as well as off of Route 122
in Cumberland.
- Additional rainfall amounts of 0.5 to 1 inch are possible in the
warned area.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Brockton, Pawtucket, Taunton, East Providence, Woonsocket,
Cumberland, Randolph, North Providence, Franklin, North
Attleborough, Norwood, Stoughton, Attleboro, Walpole and
Mansfield.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.
properties.area: Bristol, MA; Norfolk, MA; Plymouth, MA; Worcester, MA; Providence, RI

properties.title: Special Marine Warning issued September 28 at 6:29AM CDT until September 28 at 8:00AM CDT by NWS Mobile AL
properties.description:
SMWMOB

The National Weather Service in Mobile has issued a

* Special Marine Warning for...
Waters from Pensacola FL to Pascagoula MS from 20 to 60 NM...

* Until 800 AM CDT.

* At 629 AM CDT, a strong thunderstorm was located 24 nm south of
Farewell Buoy, moving southeast at 25 knots.

HAZARD...Wind gusts 34 knots or greater.

SOURCE...Radar.

IMPACT...Small craft could be damaged in briefly higher winds and
suddenly higher waves.

* The strong thunderstorm will remain over mainly open waters.
properties.area: Waters from Pensacola FL to Pascagoula MS from 20 to 60 NM

properties.title: Flood Warning issued September 28 at 7:11AM EDT until September 29 at 6:00PM EDT by NWS Boston/Norton MA
properties.description:
...The Flood Warning is extended for the following rivers in
Massachusetts...

Taunton River Near Bridgewater affecting Bristol and Plymouth
Counties.

For the Taunton River...including Bridgewater...Minor flooding is
forecast.

* WHAT...Minor flooding is forecast.

* WHERE...Taunton River near Bridgewater.

* WHEN...Until Tuesday evening.

* IMPACTS...At 8.0 feet, Backwater flooding from the Taunton River
will cause flooding of lower Purchade Brook in Middleboro.  This
will cause Woloski Park to become impassable by most vehicles.
Beware of the dangers of crossing flooded roadways.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 6:45 AM EDT Monday the stage was 7.9 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to rise above flood stage late
this morning to a crest of 8.4 feet. It will then fall below
flood stage early tomorrow afternoon.
- Flood stage is 8.0 feet.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Motorists should not attempt to drive around barricades or drive cars
through flooded areas.

Additional information is available at www.weather.gov.

The next statement will be issued this evening at 715 PM EDT.

as little to no additional precipitation is currently expected over
the next 24 to 48 hours.

properties.title: Flood Warning issued September 27 at 8:58PM EDT by NWS Melbourne FL
properties.description:
...The Flood Warning continues for the following rivers in Florida...

St Johns River Near Astor affecting Lake and Volusia Counties.

.The St Johns River at Astor remains within Minor Flood Stage and is
actively cresting due to an ongoing period of northerly winds and
tidal effects. River levels are forecast to gradually subside through
Minor Flood Stage this week.

For the St. Johns River...Astor...Minor flooding is forecast.

* WHAT...Minor flooding is occurring and minor flooding is forecast.

* WHERE...St Johns River near Astor.

* WHEN...Until further notice.

* IMPACTS...At 2.8 feet, Docks and boat ramps covered at South Moon
Fish Camp and approaching sea wall at Blair's Jungle Den. Water
approaching sites closest to the river at Fish Tales RV Resort and
Astor Landing Campground. Portion of Clair Street covered by river
water south of the Butler Boat Ramp. Docks underwater at the Astor
Bridge Marina and along Riveredge Drive. Portions of Fox Road are
covered with water nearest to the river. Acorn, Hazelnut and Redbud
roads are underwater with yards inundated.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 8:30 PM EDT Sunday the stage was 2.7 feet.
- Bankfull stage is 2.0 feet.
- Recent Activity...The maximum river stage in the 24 hours ending
at 8:30 PM EDT Sunday was 2.7 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to rise to a crest of 2.7 feet
just after midnight tonight.
- Flood stage is 2.3 feet.
- Flood History...This crest compares to a previous crest of 2.6
feet on 10/14/1996.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
